note: What a server sends to start drawing sets of particles. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: groupCount
fields.note: How many sets follow.

fields.name: groups
fields.note: The sets themselves.

fields.name: particle
fields.note: Which particle, by the number its name gives, as spec/objects.md works it out. A client draws one it does not know under a placeholder name.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: How each particle of the group behaves. What each bit does on a 1.0.0.126 client is not recorded.

fields.name: targetBone
fields.note: One place on a unit the particles hang from, by the number the name of that place gives, as spec/objects.md works it out. Whether this or bone names the place on the unit aimed at is not recorded.

fields.name: bone
fields.note: The other place on a unit the particles hang from, by the same reading.

fields.name: particleCount
fields.note: How many particles follow.

fields.name: particles
fields.note: The particles themselves.

fields.name: target
fields.note: A unit, or zero. Where a client knows it and its state allows, the client moves it to the owner position below. Whether it is the unit aimed at, the one that made the particle or the one it hangs off is not recorded.

fields.name: id
fields.note: The name this particle answers to, so later messages can name it.

fields.name: caster
fields.note: A second unit, or zero. Which part it plays for the particle is not recorded.

fields.name: atX
fields.note: Where the particle sits, along one ground axis. Carried in the units a path uses rather than in world units.

fields.name: atY
fields.note: Where it sits, in height, in world units.

fields.name: atZ
fields.note: Where it sits, along the other ground axis. It shares the reading of the first.

fields.name: towardX
fields.note: Where the particle is aimed, along one ground axis, in the form of the first pair above.

fields.name: towardY
fields.note: Where it is aimed, in height, in world units.

fields.name: towardZ
fields.note: Where it is aimed, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: ownerX
fields.note: Where the unit that made it stood, along one ground axis, in the form of the first pair above.

fields.name: ownerY
fields.note: Where that unit stood, in height, in world units.

fields.name: ownerZ
fields.note: Where that unit stood, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: facingX
fields.note: Which way the particle faces, along one ground axis.

fields.name: facingY
fields.note: Which way it faces, in height.

fields.name: facingZ
fields.note: Which way it faces, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: runningFor
fields.note: How far into its run the particle already is, in seconds.

fields.name: groupCount
fields.note: How many sets follow.

fields.name: groups
fields.note: The sets themselves.
